changes: Replaced an action-based shoulder stem not stated in the transcript with the lecturer's explicit suprascapular-nerve muscle pair.
Replaced a deltoid-abduction range stem with the lecturer's explicit axillary-nerve motor distribution.
Replaced an untaught rotator-cuff classification stem with an explicitly taught quadrangular-space boundary.
Reframed an untaught muscle-action stem around two explicit transcript facts.
Replaced an action-based stem with the lecturer's explicit posterior-wall relation.
Replaced an uncited dislocation mechanism with the lecturer's explicit axillary-nerve lesion sign.
Removed the ambiguous word 'deepest' and used a single, explicit positional discriminator.
Clarified the exception wording so a partially ulnar-supplied muscle cannot create ambiguity.
Moved the scaphoid complication from transcript-confirmed wrist scope to the Gray's-only hand/carpal extension.
Restricted the stem to a nerve and replaced the competing descending-genicular-artery option, which also leaves before the hiatus.
Replaced an imprecise claim about relaxing fascia with the relevant relaxed muscular boundaries.
Removed an unsupported temporal claim ('first threatens') while preserving the correct compartment-localization test.
Corrected the over-narrow two-tendon sling claim to the exact three-muscle set on Gray's printed p. 649.
